name: Magellan
versions: Magellan Robotic System with the Magellan robotic catheter, formerly Northstar robotic catheter (brochure LT0040 Rev C, (c) 2012); 9 F sheath / 6 F leader
target_anatomy: multi-specialty peripheral vascular (indication: navigation to anatomical targets in the peripheral vasculature, then a conduit for manual placement of therapeutic devices, hansen2016_magellan_BROCHURE p. 2); aortic; neurovascular case series (23 pts per chen2023_operating; 9 angiograms + 18 interventions per miyachi2025_robotics - conflict)
devices_driven: proprietary Magellan robotic catheter giving distal tip control of guidewires, catheters and guide (brochure p. 1); steerable sheath 9 F and leader 6 F; guidewire 0.014-0.035 in
rotation_detail: belt friction drive for guidewire; tendon-driven catheters
footprint_mm: N.R. (robotic arm at the patient table + remote physician workstation; 'no specialized construction necessary', brochure p. 1)
haptics_leader: no: remote physician workstation away from the radiation source (brochure p. 1)
key_numbers: FDA approval 2012 for PVI as written by crinnion2022_robotics (a 510(k) clearance is likely; record not opened)
